name: BH Telecom Data Centar / BH Telecom Cloud
notes: BH Telecom's official cloud page identifies BH Telecom Cloud as SDDC/VMware Cloud Verified infrastructure owned by BH Telecom; earlier official pages describe colocation in BH Telecom Data Centar and a 2021 RFI for a modular data center, followed by a 2023 tender reported by SeeNews. Location is associated with Sarajevo/Federation; MW capacity not published.

name: Logosoft Data Centar Sarajevo
notes: Operator pages describe Logosoft Data Centar and cloud services from Sarajevo; third-party listings place it at Vilsonovo setaliste 9 and note commercial colocation/cloud services opened in 2017. MW capacity not published.

name: QSS Cloud data centers Sarajevo
notes: QSS Cloud states it operates certified data centers in Bosnia and Herzegovina from Sarajevo and provides cloud infrastructure, storage/backup, network and security services; Cisco case study identifies QSS as a Sarajevo cloud provider. MW capacity not published.

name: Globalhost Data Center Novi Travnik
notes: Globalhost's colocation page describes an advanced data center in Bosnia and Herzegovina with direct optical connections, N+1 network redundancy, N+2 UPS and N+2 cooling; market directories place Globalhost in Novi Travnik, which is in the Federation. MW capacity not published.

name: QuickConnect AI / Hosting Data Center Brcko
notes: QuickConnect's site says it is building modern data centers for AI infrastructure, hosting and colocation, with location shown as Brcko, BiH; LinkedIn posts describe early-stage AI/data-backup infrastructure and a Brcko institutional/investment briefing. Treated as planned because public material indicates active project formation/site promotion rather than an operating facility. MW capacity not published.

name: LANACO Technology Center Data Center
notes: LANACO's official Technology Center page says the Banja Luka center opened in 2017, includes a modern data center, and describes it as built according to Tier 4 standards; Sarajevo Times reports the 10,000 sq m technology center includes office and data-center space. MW capacity not published.

name: m:tel Virtual Data Center / Cloud infrastructure
notes: m:tel's official business cloud pages offer Virtual Data Center, IaaS and PaaS services for business customers. The operator is headquartered in Banja Luka, Republika Srpska; public pages do not disclose the underlying facility address or MW capacity.
